facts.why: In the script McClane checks the floors and mutters '32 construction... 33 computers'. Floor 33 is the computer floor, not a building site.

facts.text: Long flight? Shoes off, stretch the legs, then grab a drink.
facts.why: The man beside McClane on the plane says to take your shoes and socks off after you arrive and make fists with your toes. He says nothing about stretching or a drink.
facts.fix: After a long flight, shoes and socks off and make fists with your toes.

fix_note.text: After a long flight, shoes and socks off and make fists with your toes.

facts.text: Same recipe as the back of the limo.
facts.why: Argyle lists the limo extras as CD, CB, TV, telephone, full bar and VHS. No nuts or snacks are mentioned.
facts.fix: Beside the full bar in the limo.

facts.why: Wikipedia calls Holly a high ranking Nakatomi executive. No vice president title is given to her in the film.
The transcript has Takagi introduced as President, Nakatomi Trading.

vibe.verdict: A clean Nakatomi party menu that gets the building and the night right. It misses the best Die Hard jokes, and a couple of titles are off.
missing: Fists with your toes on the plane (the salesman)
Hans Gruber's fake American accent (the stairwell)
Ho ho ho on the dead man's shirt
The mimosa champagne punch at the party
ideas: Fix the floors sign to '32 construction, 33 computers'
Swap the 4B tip for the salesman's fists with your toes line
Replace the 'Champagne by the bottle, Ellis picks' line with 'Mimosa champagne punch, watered down'
Swap 'Christmas Sugar Cookies' note for a Twinkies joke from the 7-Eleven
iconic: Fists with your toes (printed tip from the plane seat)
"Now I have a machine gun. Ho ho ho." not placed, no free note slot
changed: Old Fashioned note now carries Yippee-ki-yay and Mr Cowboy (phone menu only, the printed face has no note under the drink)
